_README: Hunks in cfb_mobile.html that NO valid ES-module source can reproduce, because the bundle
was hand-edited after esbuild produced it. Each was proven by building a minimal repro and
showing what esbuild actually emits — not assumed. Two independent adversarial audits
re-checked every entry and refuted none.
The recurring causes:
A. IDENTIFIER SHADOWING. The bundle is one IIFE scope, so esbuild must suffix any nested
name that collides with a top-level one (ctx from ui/sound.js, pick from engine/lore.js,
avg from engine/player.js, activeTab from views/recruiting.js). The hand-editor wrote the
un-suffixed name. AUTH's own season.js chunk proves the rename: it emits `pick2` at one
site and hand-written `pick` at another.
B. CROSS-MODULE FREE VARIABLES. The hand-editor declared a binding in one module and read or
assigned it from another with no import. Legal in one shared scope, impossible in ESM —
and a ReferenceError under the native-ES-module dev path in index.html.
C. HOISTING OUT OF THE __esm WRAPPER. esbuild hoists every top-level binding of a wrapped
module into `var X;` plus an assignment inside init_<mod>(). The bundle has a few left
inline in the module body.
D. OPTIONAL-CHAINING TEMPS. esbuild allocates _a, _b, ... sequentially per function and never
reuses or skips. The bundle carries dead temps and out-of-sequence names left behind when
the hand-editor deleted the code that had allocated them.
E. TREE-SHAKEN DEAD CODE. The bundle contains bindings with no remaining consumer. esbuild
drops them, so no source can put them back.
In every case the SOURCE holds the correct, idiomatic form. The rebuilt bundle differs from
cfb_mobile.html only in these names and placements — never in behaviour.

js~engine~season.js.why: A: un-suffixed ctx/pick/avg (AUTH's own chunk emits pick2 elsewhere, proving the rename). C: GRADE_LETTERS left in the module body though season.js is __esm-wrapped. D: dead temps _h,_i,_j in updateAICarousel; _a,_b,_c reused across two sites in cascadeCarousel; _a3,_b3 in a two-level arrow where esbuild numbers _a2,_b2. Plus an inner catch (e2) where the outer catch is not an ancestor scope

js~ui~views~depthchart.js.why: D: a vestigial `var _a2, _b2;` in renderDepthOrder's ids.map callback — the only occurrence of either name in the whole chunk, left behind when the do-slotbtn block was hand-deleted — which forces a renumbering cascade through the nested scopes. Plus 1 line from the FORMATION_PLAYBOOK relocation (see js~constants.js)

js~ui~app.js.why: B: the bundle uses PASS_CONCEPTS, flushSaveSync and saveGame with no import, so source must add them and emit the init_concepts()/init_persistence() calls the bundle lacks. A: a parameter named activeTab must become activeTab3 because top-level activeTab and activeTab2 exist in other chunks. Plus the groupTab arrangement (see js~state.js)

js~state.js.why: B: the bundle declares teamGroupTab/programGroupTab/statsGroupTab in app.js's region but assigns them from navigate() here. Assigning an imported binding is impossible in ESM, so they are declared and exported here with a setGroupTab setter — verified as the joint minimum (23 lines vs 37 for the bundle's shape, which also emits *2 suffixes and is invalid ESM). C: LEGACY_VIEW_MAP left inline in the module body though state.js is __esm-wrapped

js~ui~views~mainmenu.js.why: A: ctx → ctx2, forced by the top-level `let ctx` in ui/sound.js. D: a `_dsd` temp where esbuild names optional-call temps _a/_b

js~engine~world.js.why: C: `var REAL_SCHOOL_STEMS = new Set([...])` left inline in the module body while every sibling const is correctly hoisted. A: pick → pick2, forced by the top-level `function pick` in engine/lore.js

js~constants.js.why: B, resolved deliberately: the bundle declares FORMATION_PLAYBOOK in the depthchart view and lets sim.js reach it as a free variable. That is a ReferenceError under the native-ES-module dev path, so the table was relocated here — a leaf module both consumers already import. Costs 2 lines here and 1 in depthchart; the three alternatives were built and all scored worse

js~engine~development.js.why: A: the bundle has `const chance` where esbuild must emit `chance2`, because engine/lore.js has a top-level `chance()`. AUTH's own checkGameInjury in this same chunk uses chance2, so the file is internally inconsistent

js~engine~coachprofile.js.why: the bundle's __export list places noteCoachRecords out of alphabetical order, which esbuild always sorts. A: noteRecord's 5th parameter is spelled ctx where the top-level ctx in ui/sound.js forces ctx2

js~ui~views~dashboard.js.why: B: the bundle uses expectedWins/mandateText/seatState from engine/career.js with no import, so source must emit the init_career() call it lacks. D: a declared-but-unused `_c` and a pointless `(_b = ...)` assignment in renderExpectationsBar, left over from a hand-edit

js~engine~persistence.js.why: the bundle omits flushSaveSync from its __export list while ui/app.js calls it directly — esbuild always lists every export. D: `var _a, _b;` and `(_a = rec) == null` in loadGame, left over from an `e.target.result?.state` form the hand-editor replaced with a `rec` local (esbuild allocates no temp for a plain identifier base)

js~engine~portal.js.why: D: a mid-function `var _pa, _pb;` where esbuild hoists optional-chaining temps into the opening var list as _a, _b, ...

js~engine~rankings.js.why: E: divisionSOSRank exists in the bundle but nothing anywhere calls it (grepped every AUTH chunk), so esbuild tree-shakes it. Kept as a proper export in source

js~engine~recruiting.js.why: E: NARROW_START is dead in the bundle — buildNarrowSchedule was its only reader and the hand-editor deleted the function but left the constant. B: projectedPathToPlay is called cross-module with no import, so source must emit an init_portal() the bundle lacks

js~ui~views~gameplan.js.why: D: the bundle reuses _a/_b in the simple-mode halftime branch although esbuild already assigned them to the advanced branch's ?? lowerings in the same function

js~ui~views~recruiting.js.why: D: the bundle keeps dead temps _f/_g and uses _h where esbuild must emit _f — leftovers from the hand-deletion of the narrowSchedule expressions

js~ui~views~standings.js.why: B: the bundle declares _sosCache in schedule.js's region but reads and assigns it inside renderStandings(). It is only ever used here, so it was moved here; costs 1 line in each of the two chunks

js~ui~views~schedule.js.why: B: the mirror of the _sosCache move — the bundle has a declaration here that nothing in this module uses

js~ui~views~scheduling.js.why: B: the bundle calls scheduleGuarantee() with no import, so source must emit the init_portal() call it lacks
